name: smwmusic-beyond-good-and-evil-home-sweet-home
title: Beyond Good and Evil - Home Sweet Home
description:
This is the popular piano track from Beyond Good & Evil that plays once you enter Hillys for the first time. This would go well as an atmospheric track or in a water level.

This was a beast to port, mostly because I wanted good piano samples and those take up a ton of space, so sacrifices had to be made with echo.
